name: cron-kit-monorepo
description: cron-kit —— Cron 表达式可视化组件库（Vue 3 / React 双端，零运行时依赖）

scripts.build: npm run build -w cron-kit-core && npm run build -w cron-kit-react && npm run build -w cron-kit-vue
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:ui
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w cron-kit-core && npm run typecheck -w cron-kit-react && npm run typecheck -w cron-kit-vue
scripts.demo: npm run build -w playground-react && npm run build -w playground-vue && node scripts/bundle-demo.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run check:docs
